title: Can I BEAT King of the Bridge? (Overkill Ending)
summary: Return to King of the Bridge to earn the 'Overkill' achievement: beat the Troll while keeping at least 10 of your 16 white pieces. He hedges against the Troll's typical cheats (e.g. pawns capturing diagonally like normal chess, bishops going out of town), moves bishops out of town to dodge threats, accuses cheats (mostly Rule 2 'only move your own pieces' - 'get your grubby green hand off'), and uses each payback cheat to remove the Troll's strongest pieces. Achieved after about 45 attempts.
rules: Achievement goal: win with at least 10 white pieces remaining (of 16).
In this game pawns move orthogonally (up, down, left, right); the Troll often 'cheats' by moving/capturing diagonally like normal chess.

Base game rules as in WEYUcaJTBso (King of the Bridge): accusation via Space + rule book; correct accusation = you may cheat once; false accusation = turn forfeited + troll revenge cheat; pawns move orthogonally (forward/back/sideways) not diagonally; only knights jump; only bishops may go 'out of town' off-board; troll king death passes crown to another piece; queen can't take king; slippery tiles; board flips.
win_condition: Defeat the Troll (eliminate its pieces) with >=10 of your pieces left -> Overkill achievement.
